observations: 
  [1]     observation_id: A129-E02-O01
    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E02-G01
    finding: 神经沿血管到达血管极，随后可沿Bowman囊外周延伸到其他肾小球；图示未显示纤维进入肾小球毛细血管丛。
    metric: anatomical association
    time_description: 横断面固定组织观察；年龄组不是同一人的随访时点。
    result: 
      finding: 血管极、MD邻域及囊外神经网络；神经在周边绕行并避开尿极。
    statistics: 
      biological_replicates_for_this_specific_claim: null (as recorded in source)
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        location: Results: Morphological organization; Fig.2d,h,i
      [2]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig.2d,h,i
      [3]         source_id: F03
        location: S1i,j
    limitations: 
      [1] 图像接近和连续分割不能确定突触传递、方向性或生理效应。
  [2]     observation_id: A129-E02-O02
    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E02-G01
    finding: TH相关纤维覆盖MD区域，CGRP信号主要在MD两侧；Synapsin I斑点在JGA区域富集。
    metric: marker-defined spatial localization
    time_description: 横断面固定组织观察；年龄组不是同一人的随访时点。
    result: 
      sympathetic_marker: TH
      sensory_marker: CGRP
      pan_neural_marker_in_Fig2d: TUJ1
      synaptic_related_marker: Synapsin I
      figure_panel_heading: MD with Sympathetic Nerves
      figure_caption_identity: TUJ1 red; CGRP sensory green
      movie2_annotation: 10 s identifies TUJ1/CGRP; 40 s describes sympathetic identity as an implication
    statistics: 
      quantitative_contact_rate: null (as recorded in source)
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        location: Results: Morphological organization
      [2]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig.2d
      [3]         source_id: F03
        location: S1g,i,j
      [4]         source_id: F04
        location: SD2 rows3–19及样本通道表
      [5]         source_id: F09
        location: Movie2 sampled frames at 10/30/40/50 s
    limitations: 
      [1] Fig.2d图版标题写MD with Sympathetic Nerves，图注识别TUJ1红/CGRP绿，Results以TH/CGRP解释；三者身份层级不同，不能靠伪彩消除差异或把全部TUJ1等同TH。
      [2] 缺少电生理或受体/突触超微结构验证。
  [3]     observation_id: A129-E02-O03
    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E02-G01
    finding: 从JGA进入髓放线的追踪路径中，TAL可确认为同一肾单位，而相关PT/CD归属未完全确认；另有皮质迷路PCT及跨肾单位的神经关联展示。
    metric: within-nephron versus between-nephron tracing
    time_description: 横断面固定组织观察；年龄组不是同一人的随访时点。
    result: 
      same_nephron_confirmed_in_text: TAL
      same_nephron_unresolved: 
        [1] PT in the medullary-ray example
        [2] CD in the medullary-ray example
      reason: 长路径离开视野
      separate_cortical_labyrinth_evidence: Results描述PCT接受来自自身及其他肾小球的分支；Movie3约140–170 s标注Glom1 PCT及来自Glom1/2 JGA的合并分支。
    statistics: 
      replicate_n: null (as recorded in source)
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        location: Results: Nerves connect FTUs of the same nephron and others in the community
      [2]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig.2h,i
      [3]         source_id: F09
        location: Movie3 sampled frames at 140/160/170/220 s
    limitations: 
      [1] PT/CD归属未确认的限制只针对具体髓放线追踪路径，不能扩大为所有PCT均未见同肾单位关联；也不能把Movie3局部标注升级为完整肾单位全程追踪。
  [4]     observation_id: A129-E02-O04
    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E02-G02
    finding: 髓质内神经更常伴行直小血管、近端小管和髓袢结构；集合管束相对少神经。
    metric: qualitative target preference
    time_description: 横断面固定组织观察；年龄组不是同一人的随访时点。
    result: 
      relative_pattern: vasa recta/PT/TAL more prominently associated than collecting ducts
      absolute_denervation_proportion: null (as recorded in source)
    statistics: 
      n_for_target_comparison: null (as recorded in source)
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        location: Results: Innervation pattern in the medulla
      [2]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig.2j–m
      [3]         source_id: F09
        location: Movie4 adult frames 0–120 s; second section explicitly labeled neonatal at 200 s
    limitations: 
      [1] 这是代表图的相对形态描述，不是受体特异性或完全无神经的证明。

    finding: 参考肾小球血管极显示方向偏倚，成人极角呈双峰；新生儿分布缺少同样双峰外观。

        young_adult: 0.00018
    statistics: 
      test: Kolmogorov–Smirnov normality assessment, source wording
      unit: glomeruli nested in donors
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        location: Fig.2c/5c captions; Results: Neuro-nephron patterning
      [2]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig.2c,5c
      [3]         source_id: F04
        location: SD3

    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E03-G01
    finding: 肾小球密度由外皮质向内侧下降，集合管密度向髓质增加；皮质周肾小球神经量大体稳定。

        glomerular_density: 4F/3M
        collecting_duct: 4F/2M
        nerve_density: 1F/3M

      group_level_exact_mean: null (as recorded in source)

        location: Fig.2e–g
      [2]         source_id: F01
        location: Fig.2 legend; depth-distribution results
      [3]         source_id: F04
        location: SD4–8
    limitations: 
      [1] 浅表5x变化可能受细纤维信号减弱影响；20x结果支持较稳定分布。
  [3]     observation_id: A129-E03-O03
    group_ids: 
      [1] A129-E03-G01
    finding: 归一化后的自动和手动结果在已选FOV中呈相似浅趋势，差异检验p=0.761。
    metric: manual-versus-automatic validation
    time_description: 横断面固定组织观察；年龄组不是同一人的随访时点。
    result: 
      manual_glomeruli: 120
      automated_glomeruli: 194
      FOVs: 7
      samples: 2
      donors: 1
      p: 0.761
    statistics: 
      test: two-sided Welch t test
      normalization: 给自动读数加一个由选定FOV差值得到的常数偏移
      equivalence_test: false
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F03
        location: S1d图和第3页图注
      [2]         source_id: F01
        location: Methods: Validating automated neural innervation analysis
    limitations: 
      [1] 两者度量和纳入肾小球集合不同；p>0.05不能当作等效、逐对象准确率或无偏性验证。

title: 多尺度LSFM采集、拼接及配准
record_type: independent_readout_and_analysis
purpose: 按真实观察尺度与分析支线保存方法；不运行或优化原算法。
applicability: 
  sample: A129 LSFM tissue volumes;resolution/marker-specific branches
start_state: P001匹配组织。
end_state: 原始/拼接降采样体数据以及近似配准坐标。
provenance: 
  source: original22-pagepaper+SupplementaryData workbook
materials: 
  [1] ZEISSLightsheet7
  [2] ZEN/Stitchy;FIJI;Imaris;Cellpose/Labkit asstep-scoped
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 本记录章节顺序仅为阅读组织；独立支线不串成全样本必经操作。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A129-P002-SEC01
    title: 多尺度LSFM采集、拼接及配准
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P002-S01
        title: LSFM装载与5×全片定位
        action: 用少量superglue将匹配后组织固定到玻璃盖片，装入1.52折射率CargilleOil成像腔；ZeissLightsheet7先5×拍全样本，zoom0.4–1.0按尺寸。
        parameters: 
          mount: small amountofsuperglue toglasscoverslip
          immersion_chamber: CargilleOil,RI1.52
          instrument: ZEISSLightsheet7
          first_pass: 5×,zoom0.4–1.0,entire specimen
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp13: ImagingusingLSFM
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 胶的具体产品/固化条件、液量未报。EasyIndex是前处理匹配剂；CargilleOil是成像腔介质，不混为一个步骤/配方。
        legacy_rows: 
[]

        parameters: 
          usual: 20×resolutionlens;dual10×illuminators;zoom1.0;2×2tile;1mmZ;about1mm³

protocol_records:
record_id: A129-P003
title: 按倍率/结构分割、人工修订及读出mask
record_type: independent_readout_and_analysis
purpose: 按真实观察尺度与分析支线保存方法；不运行或优化原算法。
applicability: 
  sample: A129 LSFM tissue volumes;resolution/marker-specific branches
start_state: P002拼接降采样体图像与原标记通道。
end_state: 相互区分的形态mask、网络mask、神经密度输入和核标签。
provenance: 
  source: original22-pagepaper+SupplementaryData workbook
materials: 
  [1] ZEISSLightsheet7
  [2] ZEN/Stitchy;FIJI;Imaris;Cellpose/Labkit asstep-scoped
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 本记录章节顺序仅为阅读组织；独立支线不串成全样本必经操作。
  [2] S02为各分割支线在产生mask之后调用的共享转换/面生成模块，不按目录顺序在分割前预执行，也不重复执行。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A129-P003-SEC01
    title: 按倍率/结构分割、人工修订及读出mask
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P003-S01
        title: 监督分割模型及迭代人工训练
        action: Cellpose2/3模型由人工分割2D图训练；Labkit为每FOV从头训练。保留训练数据规模和目标分工，失败时加入新人工分割并重训。
        parameters: 
          Cellpose_training: 
            NPHS1_20x: 179images across6datasets
            NPHS1_5x: 16images across4datasets
            AQP2_20x: 46images across3datasets
            DAPI: 3images across2datasets
            epochs_each: 10000
          Labkit: custommodel foreachFOV;Tuj1nerves5×/20×;CD31/CD34vessels5×/20×;CD/PT/TAL5×
          retraining: additionalmanuallysegmentednewimages wheninadequate
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp13: Masking
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: Maskingcontinued
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 模型其余超参数、学习率、train/test独立性、每次新增图数未報；这是作者已报告训练，不生成新模型或优化建议。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A129-P003-S02
        title: 二值通道与isosurface
        action: Cellpose/Labkit灰度TIFF转8bit，非零设255。ImarisFileConverter按正确XYZ体素尺寸转IMS，叠到拼接降采样数据；二值等值面阈值0.125、关闭平滑，必要时按体素大小删除小误标对象，并人工验证所有面。
        parameters: 
          binary: nonzero→255 inFIJIorPython,8bit
          file: TIFF→IMS withcorrectXYZvoxel dimensions
          binary_surface_threshold: 0.125
          surface_smoothing: disabled
          small_object_filter: voxel-size thresholdasneeded
          validation: manual forallis surfaces
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: MaskingandThresholding
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 小对象阈值具体数值、人工验证准则未报。该0.125是二值通道isosurface阈值，不是抗体原图通用分割阈值。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
        execution_scope: Sharedconversionmodule,invokedoncefor eachappropriatebranchmask;notexecutedbeforesegmentationoragainasextraprocessing.
      [3]         step_id: A129-P003-S03
        title: 5×肾小球mask支线
        action: 以5×Cellpose2分割，Imaris按形态尺寸作seedseparation分开融合体；手工去掉组织外光片shadow误标，再用正确surface遮罩原二值glom通道并导出分析mask。
        parameters: 
          target: 5×NPHS1glomeruli
          separation: Imarissurfacesseedseparation
          artefact_removal: manual adjacentemptyspaceshadows
          output: correctedsurfacemasksoriginalbinaryglomchannel,export
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: Segmentingglomeruli
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] seed尺寸等参数未報；shadow去除不是以任意全局强度剔除所有弱小球。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A129-P003-S04
        title: 5×小管、神经及血管平行mask
        action: CD/PT/TAL以Labkit+Imarissurface。CD与NPHS1共二抗通道时必要时去掉glom信号。神经Labkit后用Filaments连贯化，再ConvertFilamentstoChannel导出网络mask。血管可按壁标记或腔内空区分割，去掉组织边缘误区，只用于展示。
        parameters: 
          tubules: Labkit→surface;NPHS1removedfromCDifsharedchannel
          nerve: Labkit→ImarisFilaments→ConvertFilamentstoChannel→TIFFfornetwork
          vessel_alternatives: 
            [1] CD31/CD34wall signal
            [2] emptylumenvolume
          vessel_scope: visualizationonly,nointendedquantitation;laterPODXLbetterbutalso marks podocytes
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: SegmentingCDs/TALs/PTs,Nerves,Vessels
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 不把神经Filaments网络mask代替后面神经密度使用的原Tuj1mask；腔/壁两种mask不混为同一计量。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [5]         step_id: A129-P003-S05
        title: 20×肾小球形态mask与网络mask分开
        action: 通常先ImarisSpots圈出肾小球粗ROI，再Cellpose精分和Imarissurface人工修剪；强信号高密度图可跳过Spots。形态分析把融合体以单切面分开；网络另建无接触mask，用两个切面删中间接触区，或部分高密度图降采样后3Dwatershed。
        parameters: 
          roughROI: ImarisSpots,conditionalomissionforstrongdenseimages
          fine: Cellpose→Imarissurface
          manualcleanup: weakNPHS1 adjacenttubulefalsemaskremoved
          morphology_split: oneclippingplane
          network_split: twoclippingplanes,deletein-betweencontactregion
          network_alternative: high-density volumes,downsample thenMorphoLibJ DistanceTransformWatershed3D
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: 20xSegmentingglomeruli
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp16: continued
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 形态与网络mask不可无条件共用；Spots尺寸、细分割参数、降采样倍率在本段未给，不能直接套V1网络后续5倍。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [6]         step_id: A129-P003-S06
        title: 20×小管/神经/血管支线
        action: 20×CD用Cellpose后转surface；没有训练Cellpose的PT/TAL仅在Imaris用filamenttracer手工描内部，用于可视和定性。神经Labkit→Filaments→通道用于网络；血管Labkit→filament或surface，仅展示。
        parameters: 
          CD: Cellpose→surface
          PT_TAL: manualinternalfilamenttracing,qualitative
          nerve: Labkit→Filaments→ConvertFilamentstoChannel→TIFFnetworkmask
          vessel: Labkit→filamentorsurface,visualizationnotquantification
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp16: 20x b–d
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 不以20×PT/TAL手工示踪伪装自动定量；CGRP/TH目标以该图样本通道为限。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [7]         step_id: A129-P003-S07
        title: 20×核分割选择
        action: 仅完全在FOV内的肾小球mask遮罩405通道，再导出TIFF用对应Cellpose分核。405穿透不足时只选表层gloms，深部低信号gloms排除。
        parameters: 
          input: 405channelmaskedbyfullycontainedgloms
          method: DAPI-trainedCellpose model
          depth_selection: oftenonlysurfacegloms;deeperexcludedforreducedsignal
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp16: 20xSegmentingnuclei
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 具体排除深度/信噪阈值未报；不是整个FOV所有肾小球都可比，不能把表层核密度外推全体。

record_id: A129-P004
title: 形态、空间方向和周边神经密度读出
record_type: independent_readout_and_analysis
purpose: 分开不同分母、倍率、对象纳入和人工/自动指标。
applicability: 
  scope: 5×/20×structuralmaskbranches;notviraltracingorfunctionalmeasurement
start_state: P003适用分割mask及P002体素/配准信息。
end_state: 作者定义的体积、密度、方向及验证读出。
provenance: 
  source: primaryMethodspp14–17;SupplementS1/S4;SD8cells
materials: 
  [1] Imaris;FIJI/MorphoLibJ;Python/SciPy/OpenCV/skimage
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 读出为相互独立的分析支线；体素数量、神经长度、体积与样本层级不混用。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A129-P004-SEC01
    title: 总体、分区、形态与方向
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P004-S01
        title: 5×总体积、尺寸与分区长度
        action: 为加速先建临时降采样图，在5×488通道生成关闭平滑的surface，阈值调至包围全组织且无背景，导出体积并生成组织mask。MeasurementPoints量长宽、皮质顶至CMJ和CMJ至髓质底。
        parameters: 
          software: Imaris
          whole_sample: 488autogeneratedsurface,manualthreshold,smoothingoff
          outputs: 
            [1] tissuevolume
            [2] tissuebinarymask
            [3] length
            [4] width
            [5] corticallength
            [6] medullarylength
          data: SD11
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: Basicsamplemeasurements
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 原始组织面阈值未给，不能套用二值mask等值面0.125；临时降采样倍率/长度边界选择未全述。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A129-P004-S02
        title: 5×肾小球计数及皮质占据区密度
        action: FIJIMorphoLibJ DistanceTransformWatershed3D分开glom分析mask并计数；SciPyConvexHull包围全部glom信号，以数量/此凸包体积得到皮质glom密度。
        parameters: 
          count: 3Dwatershed of5×analysisglomerulus masks
          density_denominator: 3Dconvexhull ofglomeruli-occupiedspace,notwholekidneyvolume
          density: glomcount / convexhullvolume
          reported_check: SK5count97%accuracy versusmanual,exampleonly
          data: SD11
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: Determiningglomerularcountanddensity
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 凸包是来源定义的皮质体积代理，非真实解剖皮质精分割；97%只为该例检查，不当全队列准确率。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A129-P004-S03
        title: 5×沿皮髓方向的平面密度分布
        action: 沿Y轴逐面统计目标阳性体素占二值mask体素比例，导出深度与密度；glom/CD极端端部离群值按IQR规则处理。神经密度分为n=5的buckets。仅以Y从皮质到髓质的图进行此轴分析。
        parameters: 
          plane_axis: Y
          source_ratio: np.count_nonzero target signal / voxelcount ofbinarymask
          outlier_bounds: Q1−1.5IQR andQ3+1.5IQR forglom/CD distributions
          nerve_buckets: n=5 asreported
          orientation_exclusion: differentlyorientedimages notusedforthisanalysis
          data: 
            [1] SD4
            [2] SD5
            [3] SD6
          Fig5_violin: planarnerve-density surrogate distribution
          SD4_distinct_outputs: 
            [1] glomerularvolume/samplevolume
            [2] glomerularcount perµm³tissue
          SD5_output: collectingductvolume/samplevolume
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: Determiningdensitiesacrossregions
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: SUPP_DATA
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM12_ESM.xlsx
            locator: SD 4 - Glomerular Distributions!A1:D3
            source_raw: 
              A1: Supplemental Data 4.  Longitudinal Distribution of Glomeruli in Cortex. Contains the distributions of glomeruli for several samples with respect to the y-axis, from the cortical capsule to the cortico medullary junction (CMJ). Distributions measure both volume and numerical glomerular count.
              A2: Sample ID: SK1
              B2: Glomerular Volume Distribution
              C2: Sample ID: SK1
              D2: Glomerular Count Distribution
              A3: Cortical Depth (um)
              B3: Vol of Glom Tissue/Vol of Sample
              C3: Cortical Depth (um)
              D3: Number of Glomeruli/um3 of tissue
            checked_this_round: true
          [3]             source_id: SUPP_DATA
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM12_ESM.xlsx
            locator: SD 5 - CD Density Distribution!A1:E3
            source_raw: 
              A1: Supplemental Data 5. Longitudinal Distribution of Collecting Duct.  Contains the volumetric distributions of collecting ducts for several samples with respect to the y-axis, from the capsule, across the CMJ, and into the medulla (if present). Corresponding Figure 2f in the main figure.
              A2: SK1
              B2: CMJ: 4395.66
              D2: SK2
              E2: CMJ: 3847.575
              A3: Cortical Depth (um)
              B3: CD Denisty (Vol Duct/Vol Sample)
              D3: Cortical Depth (um)
              E3: CD Denisty (Vol Duct/Vol Sample)
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] bucket具体合并函数与所有mask分母边界未详细说明；depth行不是独立病人或肾小球生物重复；不能把IQR清理默认加到所有读出。
          [2] SD4同时发布体积分数和数密度，主文逐面voxelratio段未完整给出各平面glom数密度算法，不把两输出混成一个。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A129-P004-S04
        title: 20×肾小球形态和核数
        action: 仅选择完整位于FOV的glom分析surface，Imaris导出体积/球形度。核标签保持不同灰度ID，按每glom布尔mask筛核、去零并计唯一核ID；除以对应glom体积得核密度。
        parameters: 
          morphology: volume,sphericity inImaris;fullycontainedgloms only
          nucleus_count: unique nonzero labellednuclearobjects withinglom
          density: nuclearcount / correspondingglomerulusvolume
          data: 
            [1] SD12
            [2] SD15
          depth_scope: P003-S07surface-biased nucleiselection applies
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp16: Glomerulusmorphologyandcellcounts
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 核ID数是来源cell-count代理，不确认细胞类型；粘连/截断核修正未详述。体积单位由原体素校准维持。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [5]         step_id: A129-P004-S05
        title: 肾小球取向向量与可视射线
        action: 以ImarisSpots标血管极，取完全在FOV内glom，分别导出glom与pole二值TIFF并在FIJI降采样；每个pole质心配最近glom，向量从glom质心指向pole，保存角度并延长射线供回看。
        parameters: 
          vector: glomeruluscentroid→vascularpolecentroid
          matching: nearestglomerulus object
          main_notation: azimuth np.arctan2(dy/dx);polar np.arctan2(dy/dz)
          suppFigS1h_notation: azimuth np.arctan2(dy,dx);polar np.arctan2(dy,dz)
          ray: centroidthroughpole tovolumeedge;np.linspace;TIFFoverlay
          data: SD3
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp16: Determiningorientations
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: SUPP_INFO
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM1_ESM.pdf
            locator: PDFp2: FigS1h originaldiagram
            checked_this_round: true
          [3]             source_id: SUPP_INFO
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM1_ESM.pdf
            locator: PDFp3: FigS1Hcaption
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 正文商式写法与图中双参数写法并列；未读/运行代码，不宣称修复函数调用。这里polar是作者投影角定义，不改为另一个球坐标公式；降采样倍率/错配人工纠正准则未报。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
  [2]     section_id: A129-P004-SEC02
    title: 神经score与人工核对
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P004-S06
        title: 自动神经密度的骨架与分辨率统一
        action: 密度使用原Tuj1二值mask，先FIJISkeletonize(2D/3D)。SciPyzoom把glom与神经骨架数组重采样到最小参考体素；再skimage skeletonize_3d，使不同5×zoom可比。
        parameters: 
          input: Tuj1mask notImarisfilament-refinednetworkmask
          first: FIJISkeletonize(2D/3D)
          normalization: scipyzoom toreferencesmallestvoxel size
          second: skimageskeletonize_3d afterresampling
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp14: Quantifyingglom-nerveinteractions
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: continued
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 参考数组身份、插值阶次及各图归一化后体素未列全；不以原体素count直接跨倍率比较。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A129-P004-S07
        title: 5×与20×不同周边mask定义
        action: OpenCV将glom向外扩10µm；shell=扩后区域减未扩glom。5×以扩后glom区域取神经骨架，可含tuft内信号；20×只以shell取神经，排除tuft。以取到的神经白像素数除shell像素数为来源自动score。
        parameters: 
          dilation: 10µm alldimensions
          search_region: dilatedglom AND inverseoriginalglom
          5x_numerator_region: dilatedglom,includingoriginalinterior
          20x_numerator_region: searchshell,excludesoriginalinterior
          score: selectednerve-skeleton pixelcount / search-regionpixelcount
          volume_output: counts×normalized3Dvoxelsize
          data: 
            [1] SD6
            [2] SD7
            [3] SD11
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: Quantifyingglom-nerveinteractions
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 5×/20×分子支持域明确不同，不能强制同一公式实现；score不等于真实神经长度/体积或功能支配强度。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A129-P004-S08
        title: 按估计glom数加权的类别汇总
        action: 在作者所述宽类别比较中，用样本所分析glom总体积/其20×平均glom体积估计数量，再按每样本估计数占类别总数的比例加权其平均score。
        parameters: 
          estimated_count: analysedglomvolume / same-samplemean20×glomvolume
          sample_weight: sampleestimatedcount / categorytotalestimatedcount
          category_mean: sum(sampleweight×sampleaveragescore)
          scope: broadcategoryaggregate asMethodsdescribes,notreplacementforallplanarviolinrows
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: Quantifyingglom-nerveinteractions aggregateparagraph
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 这是估计数而非独立供者权重；各图具体使用aggregated或depth-distribution需保留原映射，不能据该通用段重算所有图。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A129-P004-S09
        title: 人工周边神经量测及倒数冲突
        action: 人工只选完整gloms，扩10µm，ImarisFilaments在Tuj1通道描周边神经，导出长度总和及扩前后体积。正文把density写成shell体积/长度，SD8数值及S4e图轴为长度/shell体积，两者并列。
        parameters: 
          inclusion: fullycontainedgloms
          neighbourhood: 10µm dilation
          manual: ImarisFilaments traceTuj1,summedsegmentlength
          volume: Imarissurfacestatistics
          main_formula: (dilatedglomerulusvolume−glomerulusvolume)/totalnervelength
          SD8_example_C4_F4_G4: 311/1030000=0.0003019417475728155
          suppFigS4e_unit: µm/µm³
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp15: manualneuralinnervation
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: SUPP_DATA
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM12_ESM.xlsx
            locator: SD 8 20x Manual Innervation!A1:G5
            source_raw: 
              A1: Supplemental Data 8.  Manual Nerve Innervation Densities for various 20x FOVs across Several Samples.  Contains manual quantifications of the average nerve fibers per µm3 within 10 µm of glomeruli for five 20x Samples and their FOVs.  Corresponding Figure: S1D, S3E
              A2: Sample ID
              B2: Glom Number
              C2: Neighboring Nerve Length
              D2: Glom Volume
              E2: Dilated Glom Volume
              F2: Search Volume
              G2: Neural Density
              A3: SK1
              A4: FOV1
              B4: 1
              C4: 311
              D4: 1880000
              E4: 2910000
              F4: 1030000
              G4: 0.0003019417475728155
              A5: FOV1

              C5: 789
              D5: 1900000
              E5: 2940000
              F5: 1040000
              G5: 0.0007586538461538462
            checked_this_round: true
          [3]             source_id: SUPP_INFO
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM1_ESM.pdf
            locator: PDFp8: FigS4eaxis
            checked_this_round: true
          [4]             source_id: SUPP_INFO
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM1_ESM.pdf
            locator: PDFp9: FigS4Ecaption
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 原公式互为倒数，不隐式统一，不拿自动像素score与人工长度密度作为同一单位。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [5]         step_id: A129-P004-S10
        title: 同FOV人工/自动的偏移验证
        action: 同SK1/SK2视野比较两方法；以SK1FOV2的manual−auto差值加到全部自动值，再作Welch检验。S1D注明人工仅完整gloms、自动包括全部gloms。

          offset: manualSK1FOV2−automatedSK1FOV2,addedtoallautomatedmeasurements
          test: two-sampleWelch,two-sidedperS1D;p=0.761
          S1Dcounts: manual120gloms across7FOVs;automatic194gloms

protocol_records:
record_id: A129-P005
title: 版本与尺度限定的结构网络分析
record_type: independent_readout_and_analysis
purpose: 保持V1/V2、5×/20×、主干保留/去除和mother范围的真实区别。
applicability: 
  input: segmentedglomeruliandnervefilamentmasks;structuralundirectednetworks
start_state: P003网络专用二值mask。
end_state: 配对连接、社区、modularity、degree及候选mother的限定比较。
provenance: 
  source: mainpp17–19;S2/S3;SD13/18
materials: 
  [1] NetTracer3DV1/V2asreported
  [2] Python/NetworkX/Louvain;FIJI/MorphoLibJ;Imaris;Excel
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] V1和V2是替代实现，禁止串行都做；多个地方提及10µm不意味着累计扩20µm。
  [2] 所有网络算法为原文记录，未运行、未优化，不具算法复现或功能验证状态。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A129-P005-SEC01
    title: 连接生成与替代版本
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P005-S01
        title: 定义节点、边和两种空间mask
        action: NetTracer3D以glom为节点、神经为边，构建无向结构网络。原二值glom向各向扩10µm的邻域用于分开神经网络，取邻域外神经为outeredges、邻域内为inneredges。这里是共享邻域定义，后面V1/V2再次提及不累计再扩一次。
        parameters: 
          nodes: separatedglomerulusmask
          edges: refinednerve-maskfornetwork,notdensityskeleton
          network: undirected
          shared_search_neighbourhood: 10µm fromoriginalglom
          outer_edges: nerve AND inverse(dilatedglom)
          inner_edges: nerve AND dilatedglom
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp17: Generatingnetworks/corealgorithm/Establishingedges
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 神经结构接触是形态连接推断，不代表传递方向、功能突触或因果调控。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A129-P005-S02
        title: 主干保留/去除配对分析与例外
        action: 去主干支线在outeredge数组删除最大对象；作者通常各跑保留/去除两种。5×部分样本因多条大干需重复该步骤；SK18主干在视野外未作删除。
        parameters: 
          removal: largestouteredgeobject setto0
          reported_general: pairedwith/withouttrunkanalyses
          5x_exceptions: twoinstances repeatedlargestobjectremoval;SK18 no trunkremovaloutsideFOV
          validation_context: 5xmodularityspikeafterremoval
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp17: Optionallyremovingtrunk
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp19: 5xnetworkanalysis
            checked_this_round: true
          [3]             source_id: SUPP_INFO
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/41467_2025_60435_MOESM1_ESM.pdf
            locator: PDFp5: FigS2C
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 两次重复去干的确切图像ID和删除后残留程度未完全给；不自动反复删到理想网络，也不把SK18虚构成实际删干。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A129-P005-S03
        title: V1倍率支线
        action: V1的20×支线对inner/outeredgeTIFF用FIJI最亮LUT，XYZ各scale5倍降采样，再施最亮LUT保存；Python标记对象，outeredge向各向扩1像素。节点原数组标ID后XYZ降5倍，逐节点子数组作同一搜索邻域扩张。V1的5×不做此降采样/边扩张，以10µm邻域glom经3Dwatershed保持ID。
        parameters: 
          V1_20x_edges: 8bitTIFF;maxbrightLUT;FIJIscale XYZby5 defaultsettings;maxbrightLUT;Pythonlabel;outeredge1pixel dilation
          V1_20x_nodes: labeloriginalglom,XYZdownsample5,perglomsubarraysearchdilation
          V1_5x: noedge downsampling/dilation;shared10µmglomneighbourhoodthenMorphoLibJDistanceTransformWatershed3D
          5x_example: SK5identityseparation95.4%versusmanual
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp17: DownsamplingedgesandnodesV1
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: PRIMARY_PDF
            path: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A129/sources/Main_original.pdf
            locator: PDFp18: Settingup5xV1

sections:

    title: 统计与显示
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A129-P007-S01
        title: 统计检验与圆周角预处理
